description: Find a city, town or village anywhere in the world by name and get its latitude, longitude and IANA time zone. Call this whenever the user names a place — "New York", "Lyon", "Dubai", "Jaipur" — then pass its latitude, longitude and timezone as lat, lon and tz to get_panchang, list_festivals and get_muhurat. Never guess coordinates or a time zone. Each result has a display_name with the country, so ask the user when several places share a name.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to narrow the search, e.g. "US", "IN".

q.description: Place name, e.g. "Toronto" or "Pune". Alternate names work.

name: search_locations
